explanation: Order 1 has two touches, so paid search gets half: 150 euros. Order 2 has one touch, so paid search gets all 500 euros. In order 3 paid search is the last of three touches and gets 40% of 250 = 100 euros. Paid search gets 150 + 500 + 100 = 750.00 euros. Applying 40% to the short paths as well would give only 120 + 200 + 100 = 420 euros.
